description: A butcher shop is buying meat slicers for their shop, a manual and automatic slicer. The manual slicer can cut 5 slices per minute while the automatic slicer can cut 8 slices per minute. In addition, to make sure all the parts operate smoothly, the manual slicer requires 3 units of grease per minute while the automatic slicer requires 6 units of grease per minute. Since the automatic slicer does not need someone to operate it, the number of manual slicers must be less than the number of automatic slicers. In addition, the butcher shop needs to be able to cut at least 50 slices per minute but can use at most 35 units of grease per minute. How many of each slicer should the butcher shop buy to minimize the total number of slicers in the shop?

ManualSliceRate.definition: The number of slices a manual slicer can cut per minute

AutomaticSliceRate.definition: The number of slices an automatic slicer can cut per minute

ManualGreaseRate.definition: The number of units of grease a manual slicer requires per minute

AutomaticGreaseRate.definition: The number of units of grease an automatic slicer requires per minute

MinimumSlicesPerMinute.definition: The minimum number of slices the shop needs to cut per minute

MaximumGreasePerMinute.definition: The maximum number of units of grease the shop can use per minute

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of slicers (manual and automatic) purchased by the butcher shop"

constraints.description: 5 * (number of manual slicers) + 8 * (number of automatic slicers) >= MinimumSlicesPerMinute
3 * (number of manual slicers) + 6 * (number of automatic slicers) <= MaximumGreasePerMinute
The number of manual slicers must be less than the number of automatic slicers
The number of manual slicers and the number of automatic slicers must be non-negative integers
